name: Hinte (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hinte (a yellow castle over waves on blue under a crown).
history: Municipal flag of Hinte; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Hinte arms — castle over waves on blue
